06de4d4f75ba4b57b4fb246dea7dea48 — page 10
ections: declared MCP servers (placement, auth timing, materialized server id) and declared skills (namespaced model refs). Addres
sed by the version id alone — access is membership of the version's own project, and historical versions of uninstalled…\n- [List
a project's skills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/skills/list-a-projects-skills.md): The Cloud Skills visible to the calle
r in this project: the project-shared ones plus the caller's own drafts. Each row reports `pinnability`, which is what decides whe
ther its id is usable in an environment's `skillSelection`.\n- [Get a skill](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/skills/get-a-sk
ill.md): One skill, including its SKILL.md body. The body is mutable and an edit overwrites the previous one in place, so `aggrega
teHash` is the only handle on which content this read returned.\n- [Run one headless agent turn](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/agent/run-one-headless-agent-turn.md): Runs ONE assistant turn over the supplied message history and responds synchronously w
ith the final assistant text, the operations it invoked, references to any resources it created, and any actions awaiting human ap
proval.\n- [Connect an MCP server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/connect-an-mcp-server.md): Starts a co
nnection request for an MCP server URL. Discovery, browser consent, and validation happen asynchronously; poll the returned `conne
ctionRequestId` until the status is terminal. When the next step belongs to a person, the response carries a `handoffUrl` to open.
\n- [Get a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/get-a-connection-request.md): Current stat
e of one connection request. Metered on its own poll budget rather than the shared per-caller one, so polling on a short interval
is expected and will not spend the budget your other calls need. A 429 here means the poll interval itself is too fast; honour Ret
ry-After.\n- [Cancel a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/cancel-a-connection-request.md
): Stops a request and invalidates its handoff link. Cancelling an already-terminal request is a no-op.\n- [Retry validation](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/retry-validation.md): Re-arms a stalled validation immediately instead of wai
ting out its backoff. Does not revive a terminal request — after `failed`, `expired`, or `cancelled`, start a new one.\n- [List pe
rsonas](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-personas.md): The project's personas, newest first. Archived personas ar
e excluded.\n- [Create a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-persona.md): Creates one persona. To draft
several with a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/personas/generate` — that route persists nothing.\n- [Get a persona](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-persona.md): A persona that lives in a DIFFERENT project answers 404, never 403
— the route is not an existence oracle for a project you cannot see.\n- [Delete a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
swarms/delete-a-persona.md): Refused with 409 while goals still reference this persona — deleting it would strand them.\n- [Update
a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-persona.md): Partial update. Goals reference the persona by id,
so renaming one does not disturb anything pointing at it.\n- [Draft personas with a model](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/s
warms/draft-personas-with-a-model.md): Returns DRAFTS and persists nothing. That separation is deliberate: generation is the step
most likely to produce something nobody wanted, and a route that both invented and saved would make \"let me see what you'd sugges
t\" indistinguishable from \"fill my project with these\".\n- [Draft journeys for a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/swarms/draft-journeys-for-a-persona.md): Returns DRAFTS and persists nothing — see `POST /projects/{projectId}/personas/generate`
for why, and for the quota this counts against.\n- [Get a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-journey.md)
\n- [Archive a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/archive-a-journey.md): ARCHIVES rather than deletes, and the
response says so. Existing runs keep pointing at the definition they executed, so their history stays readable.\n- [Update a journ
ey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-journey.md): Editing a goal never disturbs a run already under way: a ru
n pins its own immutable snapshot of the definition at launch.\n- [List swarms](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-
swarms.md)\n- [Create a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-swarm.md): A swarm is an authoring container
holding DEFAULTS for the goals made under it. Creating one starts nothing.\n- [Get a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
swarms/get-a-swarm.md)\n- [Archive a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/archive-a-swarm.md): ARCHIVES the contain
er. The goals authored under it are not touched — they keep their own definitions and stay launchable.\n- [Update a swarm](https:/
/docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-swarm.md): Changes the container's DEFAULTS. Goals already authored under it keep t
he values they were created with — this is not a cascade.\n- [List journeys](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-jou
rneys.md): The project's goals, newest first. Archived goals are excluded.\n- [Create a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/swarms/create-a-journey.md): Creates one goal: a persona pursuing a task against one or more environments. To draft several w
ith a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/goals/generate` — that route persists nothing.\n- [List secrets](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/list-secrets.md): The project's credentials as METADATA ONLY — no value is returned by this or any
other route. Shows the project-shared secrets plus the caller's own personal ones; another member's personal secret does not appe
ar at all, not even its name.\n- [Create a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/create-a-secret.md): Store a cred
ential so environments can grant it to runs. THE VALUE TRAVELS IN THE REQUEST BODY and becomes visible to whatever makes the call.
The response is metadata only. Creating a project-shared secret requires project admin; a personal one does not.\n- [Get a secret
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/get-a-secret.md): One secret's metadata: delivery mode, host binding, sharing, and
when it was last handed to a run. Never its value. A secret from another project — and another member's personal secret — both re
ad as 404.\n- [Delete a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/delete-a-secret.md): Delete a stored credential. HAR
D — the row and the encrypted value both go, and MCPJam stops delivering it. Deliberately NOT blocked when an environment still se
lects it: refusing would leave a leaked credential undeletable until someone edited every environment naming it, and deletion must
never wa…\n- [Rotate or re-bind a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/rotate-or-re-bind-a-secret.md): Rotate th
e value and/or change how it is delivered. A rotation reaches NEW RUNS ONLY: a session already running holds the old value — mater
ialized in its box's environment, or inside an egress policy that cannot be read back — and there is no safe way to replace it mid
-run.\n- [List a journey's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-journeys-runs.md): Newest first. Compact
records — `attempts` is on the single-run read.\n- [Launch a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/launch-a-jo
urney.md): Answers **202**: the run row exists and its fan-out has started. It is not finished — poll `GET /projects/{projectId}/g
oal-runs/{runId}` until `status` leaves `running`.\n- [Get a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/get-a-j
ourney-run.md): The full record, including per-session `attempts` and `targetSummaries`.\n- [List a run's sessions](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-runs-sessions.md): One entry per chat session the run produced. Summaries, not transcrip
ts — read a transcript through the chat-session routes using `id`.\n- [Cancel a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
